data.display_address: Binghatti Heights, District 10, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience contemporary living in this spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Binghatti Heights, offering a well-designed layout, quality finishes, and a prime location in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Ideal for families, this home combines comfort, convenience, and excellent connectivity.

Property Features:

3 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Approx. 1,359 sq. ft.
Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
Modern Fully Fitted Kitchen
Built-in Wardrobes
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Private Balcony
1 Covered Parking Space
Vacant / Ready to Move

Building Amenities:

Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Gym
Children's Play Area
High-Speed Elevators
24/7 Security & Concierge
Retail Outlets

Conveniently located with easy access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Binghatti Heights provides seamless connectivity to Dubai's major destinations, making it an excellent choice for both end-users and investors.
